AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#687 @ f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/0

Independent T4 lens AUD-SOL-D12-118, agent 118.

### Prior findings and evidence applicability

- **B-687-1 closed at the reported boundary:** `41404998`/`7d7e7db4` move the unlocked-alternative predicate before the existence-query limit; the 20/21/60-alternative regressions failed before and now pass, alongside the prior Sol probe and client-scoping controls. [Builder change and commits](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5976568403) [Verified failing-before bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37172705221) [Current audit bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218308917)
- **B-687-2 withdrawn as a policy-only finding, not represented as a behavior fix:** this is the existing pending #628 migration, covered by OR-113-4's retain-pending-prefix ruling; its referenced tables sort earlier and no later migration depends on a newly created table, so no dependency-order defect was established. Its two ordering pins pass both before and after; there is no claimed failing-before migration behavior. [Ruling and dependency explanation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5976568403) [Before bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37172705221) [Forward migration check](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174418097/job/111353953626)
- **C-687-1 closed:** `41404998` removes the “our team” footer; the rendered-copy regression failed before and passes now. [Fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5976568403) [Before bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37172705221) [Current audit bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218308917)
- No original Sol APPROVE is reused: source/configuration/schema/up-down migration, moved cadence/dispatcher, actual transport dependencies, adapter/money/access helpers, fixtures/fakes and all changed tests were reviewed independently; the moved dispatcher carries the residual delivery boundary below. [Piece move and fix scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5976568403)

### B-687-3 — an Expo-rejected coach push still becomes a terminal “sent” receipt

`src/notifications/emitters/coach-alert.emitter.ts:76–85` converts `pushToCoach()`'s boolean to a delivery verdict; `src/checkout/dunning-v2/dunning-v2.dispatcher.ts:354–378` accepts that verdict and reports successful push telemetry. The actual dependency's `notifications.service.ts:579–610` returns true after receiving an error ticket without checking its status; its boolean means an attempt, not verified provider acceptance. This is the new receipt boundary's incompatible dependency contract, not an unrelated-PR blocker. [Emitter](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c/src%2Fnotifications%2Femitters%2Fcoach-alert.emitter.ts) [Dispatcher](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c/src%2Fcheckout%2Fdunning-v2%2Fdunning-v2.dispatcher.ts) [Actual push contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c/src/notifications/notifications.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** real NotificationsService → real CoachAlertEmitter → real dispatcher, with only Expo stubbed to return `{status:'error', details:{error:'MessageTooBig'}}`, yields `coach_push.status='sent'` rather than retryable `failed`; an accepted-ticket control passes. The prior false-return/feed-failure fixes pass but do not cover this provider-ticket contract. This is synthetic acceptance evidence, not a live Expo delivery claim. [Exact-source audit lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218308917)

**Minimal fix rule:** use an honest typed acceptance adapter that checks actual ticket outcomes and distinguishes sent/failed/skipped; rejected tickets must stay retryable, and missing/invalid tokens must not masquerade as acceptance. Preserve all three coach channels and do not duplicate already-successful feed/push work. Add real-dependency rejected/accepted-ticket controls and composed outbox retry evidence.

### B-687-4 — the shared email footer promises payment/access before success, including disputes

`src/email/templates/dunning-v2-client.hbs:9–11` unconditionally says that saving the card pays the amount and “your access stays on,” then promises cancellation cancels the unpaid amount; `dunning-v2.dispatcher.ts:263–281` supplies the same card link/footer for ordinary and late-reversal/dispute notices. Saving a card is not confirmed payment, Day-10 access can already be locked, and card/invoice recovery is not settlement of an unfavorable disputed charge. [Client template](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c/src%2Femail%2Ftemplates%2Fdunning-v2-client.hbs) [Dispatch data](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/f8e47bf40fe81064d679fc2831cedf3b1cd90b2c/src%2Fcheckout%2Fdunning-v2%2Fdunning-v2.dispatcher.ts) [Dispute/payment distinction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/688#issuecomment-5976393847)

**Executed counterexample:** dispatch a late-reversal email through the real dispatcher, capture its template data and render the real Handlebars template: the unconditional payment/access promise is present, so the truth acceptance assertion fails. The audit bundle has **2 failures / 72 passes across five suites**; the other failure is B-687-3, not an infrastructure failure. [Rendered email and suite results](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218308917)

**Minimal fix rule:** condition the rendered experience on the actual obligation and payment outcome: ordinary card update attempts payment, with access restored/retained only after confirmed success; describe Day-10 lockout truthfully. Dispute notices must not imply card saving or subscription cancellation settles the reversed charge and must provide a working resolution path. Add normal-decline/required-action, already-locked and dispute render controls; keep every rendered clause consistent, not only the footer.

### Gates, size and limits

Candidate **11/11 required checks are green**, but #687 remains behind main; green checks do not override these two Bs or authorize merge/deploy. Size independently matches **2,489 additions + 228 deletions = 2,717 changed lines**, including tests, within the 3,000 hard cap and the operator's logical-piece KEEP assessment. [Candidate build](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174418115/job/111357578068) [Current size/fix scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5976568403) [Operator assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/687#issuecomment-5975773063)

The audit-only lane replays prior Sol probes, builder foundation regressions, cadence and importing-emitter tests plus the new acceptance probes; no candidate source, production flag or deployment was changed. D3's original B-628-11 is not adjudicated here; the stack must land as one and deploy only after D5.
